faqs.title: Does joining NJROTC create a military service obligation?
faqs.description: No. NJROTC is a citizenship and leadership program and participation does not create a military service obligation.

faqs.title: What activities are represented on this website?
faqs.description: The current unit content identifies drill and ceremony, athletics and fitness, academic teams, and community service.

faqs.title: Where can I find the weekly schedule?
faqs.description: Use the Plan of the Week page. Current details appear there after the unit webmaster publishes an approved plan.

faqs.title: How can I learn about joining?
faqs.description: Talk with your school counselor or visit the NJROTC classroom. Verified official contact details are published on the Contact page.

joining.title: Talk with your school counselor
joining.description: Contact the Bethel High School Counseling Office through the school’s main number, 203-794-8600, to ask how NJROTC fits into your course plan.

joining.title: Contact the NJROTC instructors
joining.description: Email Commander Andrew Ipkevich or Master Sergeant Joe Meehan using the official school contact details above.
